## Result

The analysis found **no support for a positive whole-brain gain effect in vmPFC**: no voxel survived one-sided max-T familywise correction across the brain (5,000 sign flips; peak *t*(53) = 0.90, FWE *p* = 1.000; zero voxels at FWE *p* < .05). The NARPS instructions require whole-brain-corrected results for the hypothesis decision ([original instructions](https://www.narps.info/files/narps_instructions_for_analysis_teams.pdf)).

In the independently defined vmPFC sphere, the mean estimate was −0.0061 cope units (95% CI [−0.0342, 0.0221]). This interval includes zero, so the result does not establish that the true effect is absent. The cope units also cannot be interpreted as BOLD change per currency unit.
